Guild listing: Engineering Guild. Published by Phoenix Collective (Falkor's team) from the guild's own public text (shortened, verbatim excerpts; full text in ORIGINALS.md), supplied by the Founder.

Leader: @Caioasc

Even if you're part of another guild, the Engineering Guild offers unique advantages that complement and enhance your current experiences. Our guild is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of innovation, providing unparalleled resources, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.

Cross-Guild Collaboration: Enhance your engineering projects by collaborating with experts from diverse fields, bringing fresh perspectives and innovative solutions.

Join us here: https://discord.gg/abBzwgy8Fr
